# An actual skygo server on this host's local target.

skygo-server start

# CPU and memory requests survive import and plan against real host inventory.
# Planning creates no job and does not enforce CPU or memory limits.
skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --target local admission.yaml
cp stdout admission.json
cmp admission.json want-admission.json
skygo plan -f admission.json
stdout '\Alocal\n\z'
! stderr .
skygo --json plan -f admission.json
stdout '"target": *"local"'
! stdout '"id"'
! stderr .
skygo jobs list
cmp stdout jobs-empty.txt

# Imported resource fields are never dropped. This fixture also requests an
# image, which local execution refuses at plan time without creating a job.
skycompat import --shell /bin/bash --target local --timeout-seconds 3600 $IMPORT/accept/resources.yaml
cp stdout resources.json
! skygo plan -f resources.json
stderr 'failed_precondition:.*local: unsupported by local execution: images'
skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref $IMPORT/workdir-ref.json --output out --target local --allow-drop name $IMPORT/kubernetes/task.yaml
cp stdout kubernetes.json
! skygo plan -f kubernetes.json
skygo jobs list
cmp stdout jobs-empty.txt

# A workspace import against a server without the artifact snapshot
# service is refused before submission.
skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref $IMPORT/workdir-ref.json --output out --target local --allow-drop name $IMPORT/local/task.yaml
cp stdout local.json
! skygo run -f local.json --wait --request-id import-workspace
stderr 'endpoint does not advertise artifact-snapshot-service-v1'
skygo jobs list
cmp stdout jobs-empty.txt

# A plain import runs its text byte-exact as /bin/sh -c TEXT.
skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --target local --env OUT=$WORK/result.txt print.yaml
cp stdout print.json
skygo run -f print.json --wait --request-id import-print
stdout '\tlocal\tsucceeded\n\z'
cmp $WORK/result.txt want-result.txt
skygo jobs list
stdout -count=1 'succeeded'

skygo-server stop

-- print.yaml --
run: |
  printf '%s|%s|%s\n' "it's" "$(printf 'a  b')" '$HOME' > "$OUT"
  printf 'tab\there ✓\n' >> "$OUT"
-- want-result.txt --
it's|a  b|$HOME
tab	here ✓
-- jobs-empty.txt --
ID  TARGET  STATE
-- admission.yaml --
run: unused
resources:
  cpus: 1
  memory: 1Ki
-- want-admission.json --
{
  "argv": ["/bin/sh", "-c", "unused"],
  "cpu_millis": 1000,
  "memory_bytes": 1024,
  "target": "local"
}
